H3500.def: the same as «03499»; Jether, the name of five or six Israelites and of one Midianite:--Jether, Jethro. Compare «03503».

H3501.def: by variation for «03502»; Jithra, an Israelite (or Ishmaelite):--Ithra.

H3502.def: feminine of «03499»; properly, excellence, i.e. (by implication) wealth:--abundance, riches.

H3503.def: from «03499» with pron. suffix; his excellence; Jethro, Moses' father-in-law:--Jethro. Compare «03500».

H3505.def: patronymically from «03500»; a Jithrite or descendant of Jether:--Ithrite.

H3506.def: from «03498»; excellent; Jithran, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite:--Ithran.

H3507.def: from «03499» and «05971»; excellence of people; Jithream, a son of David:--Ithream.

H3508.def: feminine active participle of «03498»; the lobe or flap of the liver (as if redundant or outhanging):--caul.

H3509.def: of uncertain derivation; Jetheth, an Edomite: -Jetheth.

H3510.def: a primitive root; properly, to feel pain; by implication, to grieve; figuratively, to spoil:--grieving, mar, have pain, make sad (sore), (be) sorrowful.

H3511.def: from «03510»; suffering (physical or mental), adversity:--grief, pain, sorrow.

H3512.def: a primitive root; to despond: causatively, to deject:--broken, be grieved, make sad.

H3513.def: or kabed {kaw-bade'}; a primitive root; to be heavy, i.e. in a bad sense (burdensome, severe, dull) or in a good sense (numerous, rich, honorable; causatively, to make weighty (in the same two senses):--abounding with, more grievously afflict, boast, be chargeable, × be dim, glorify, be (make) glorious (things), glory, (very) great, be grievous, harden, be (make) heavy, be heavier, lay heavily, (bring to, come to, do, get, be had in) honour (self), (be) honourable (man), lade, × more be laid, make self many, nobles, prevail, promote (to honour), be rich, be (go) sore, stop.

H3514.def: from «03513»; weight, multitude, vehemence: -grievousness, heavy, great number.

H3515.def: from «03513»; heavy; figuratively in a good sense (numerous) or in a bad sense (severe, difficult, stupid):--(so) great, grievous, hard(-ened), (too) heavy(-ier), laden, much, slow, sore, thick.

H3516.def: the same as «03515»; the liver (as the heaviest of the viscera):--liver.

H3518.def: a primitive root; to expire or (causatively) to extinguish (fire, light, anger):--go (put) out, quench.

H3519.def: rarely kabod {kaw-bode'}; from «03513»; properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness:--glorious(-ly), glory, honour(-able).

H3520.def: irreg. feminine passive participle of «03513»; weightiness, i.e. magnificence, wealth:--carriage, all glorious, stately.

H3521.et: from the same as (03525) in the sense of limitation
H3521.def: from the same as «03525» in the sense of limitation; sterile; Cabul, the name of two places in Palestine:--Cabul.

H3522.et: from an unused root meaning to heap up
H3522.def: from an unused root meaning to heap up; hilly; Cabon, a place in Palestine:--Cabbon.

H3523.et: from (03527) in the original sense of plaiting
H3523.def: from «03527» in the original sense of plaiting; a matrass (of intertwined materials):--pillow.

H3524.def: from «03527»; vast, whether in extent (figuratively, of power, mighty; of time, aged), or in number, many:--+ feeble, mighty, most, much, strong, valiant.

H3525.et: from an unused root meaning to twine or braid together
H3525.def: from an unused root meaning to twine or braid together; a fetter:--fetter.

H3526.def: a primitive root; to trample; hence, to wash (properly, by stamping with the feet), whether literal (including the fulling process) or figurative:--fuller, wash(-ing).

H3527.def: a primitive root; properly, to plait together, i.e. (figuratively) to augment (especially in number or quantity, to accumulate):--in abundance, multiply.

H3528.def: from «03527»; properly, extent of time, i.e. a great while; hence, long ago, formerly, hitherto:--already, (seeing that which), now.

H3529.def: the same as «03528»; length; Kebar, a river of Mesopotamia:--Chebar. Compare «02249».

H3530.def: feminine of «03528»; properly, length, i.e. a measure (of uncertain dimension):--X little.

H3531.def: from «03527» in its original sense; a sieve (as netted):--sieve.

H3532.et: from an unused root meaning to dominate
H3532.def: from an unused root meaning to dominate; a ram (just old enough to butt):--lamb, sheep.

H3533.def: a primitive root; to tread down; hence, negatively, to disregard; positively, to conquer, subjugate, violate:--bring into bondage, force, keep under, subdue, bring into subjection.

H3535.def: or kabsah {kab-saw'}; feminine of «03532»; a ewe:--(ewe) lamb.

H3536.def: from «03533»; a smelting furnace (as reducing metals):--furnace.

H3537.et: from an unused root meaning to deepen
H3537.def: from an unused root meaning to deepen; properly, a pail; but generally of earthenware; a jar for domestic purposes:--barrel, pitcher.

H3538.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «03576»; false: -lying.

H3539.et: from the same as (03537) in the sense of striking fire from a metal forged
H3539.def: from the same as «03537» in the sense of striking fire from a metal forged; a sparkling gem, probably the ruby:--agate.

H3540.def: of foreign origin; Kedorlaomer, an early Persian king:--Chedorlaomer.

H3541.def: from the prefix k and «01931»; properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now:--also, here, + hitherto, like, on the other side, so (and much), such, on that manner, (on) this (manner, side, way, way and that way), + mean while, yonder.

H3543.def: a primitive root; to be weak, i.e. (figuratively) to despond (causatively, rebuke), or (of light, the eye) to grow dull:-- darken, be dim, fail, faint, restrain, × utterly.

H3544.def: from «03543»; feeble, obscure:--somewhat dark, darkish, wax dim, heaviness, smoking.

H3545.def: feminine of «03544»; properly, a weakening; figuratively, alleviation, i.e. cure:--healing.

H3546.def: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to «03201» and «03557»; to be able:--be able, could.

H3547.et: a primitive root, apparently meaning to mediate in religious services
H3547.def: a primitive root, apparently meaning to mediate in religious services; but used only as denominative from «03548»; to officiate as a priest; figuratively, to put on regalia:--deck, be (do the office of a, execute the, minister in the) priest('s office).

H3548.def: active participle of «03547»; literally, one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman):--chief ruler, × own, priest, prince, principal officer.

H3551.et: from a root corresponding to (03854) in the sense of piercing
H3551.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «03854» in the sense of piercing; a window (as a perforation):--window.

H3552.def: of foreign derivation; Kub, a country near Egypt:--Chub.

H3553.et: from an unused root meaning to be high or rounded
H3553.def: from an unused root meaning to be high or rounded; a helmet (as arched):--helmet. Compare «06959».

H3554.def: a primitive root; properly, to prick or penetrate; hence, to blister (as smarting or eating into):--burn.

H3556.et: probably from the same as (03522) (in the sense of rolling) or (03554) (in the sense of blazing)
H3556.def: probably from the same as «03522» (in the sense of rolling) or «03554» (in the sense of blazing); a star (as round or as shining); figuratively, a prince:--star((-gazer)).

H3557.def: a primitive root; properly, to keep in; hence, to measure; figuratively, to maintain (in various senses):--(be able to, can) abide, bear, comprehend, contain, feed, forbearing, guide, hold(-ing in), nourish(-er), be present, make provision, receive, sustain, provide sustenance (victuals).

H3558.et: from an unused root meaning to store away
H3558.def: from an unused root meaning to store away; a jewel (probably gold beads):--tablet.

H3559.def: a primitive root; properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous):--certain(-ty), confirm, direct, faithfulness, fashion, fasten, firm, be fitted, be fixed, frame, be meet, ordain, order, perfect, (make) preparation, prepare (self), provide, make provision, (be, make) ready, right, set (aright, fast, forth), be stable, (e-)stablish, stand, tarry, × very deed.

H3560.def: probably from «03559»; established; Kun, a place in Syria:--Chun.

H3561.def: from «03559»; something prepared, i.e. a sacrificial wafer:--cake.

H3562.def: from «03559» and «03050»; Jah has sustained; Conanjah, the name of two Israelites:--Conaniah, Cononiah. Compare «03663».

H3563.et: from an unused root meaning to hold together
H3563.def: from an unused root meaning to hold together; a cup (as a container), often figuratively, a lot (as if a potion); also some unclean bird, probably an owl (perhaps from the cup-like cavity of its eye):--cup, (small) owl. Compare «03599».

H3564.et: from an unused root meaning properly, to dig through
H3564.def: from an unused root meaning properly, to dig through; a pot or furnace (as if excavated):--furnace. Compare «03600».

H3565.def: from «03564» and «06227»; furnace of smoke; Cor-Ashan, a place in Palestine:--Chor-ashan.

H3566.def: or (Ezra 1:1 (last time),2) Koresh {ko'-resh}; from the Persians; Koresh (or Cyrus), the Persian king:--Cyrus.

H3568.def: probably of foreign origin; Cush (or Ethiopia), the name of a son of Ham, and of his territory; also of an Israelite:--Chush, Cush, Ethiopia.

H3569.def: patronymically from «03568»; a Cushite, or descendant of Cush:--Cushi, Cushite, Ethiopian(-s).

H3570.def: the same as «03569»; Cushi, the name of two Israelites:--Cushi.

H3572.def: perhaps from «03568»; Cushan, a region of Arabia: -Cushan.

H3573.et: apparently from (03572) and the dual of (07564)
H3573.def: apparently from «03572» and the dual of «07564»; Cushan of double wickedness; Cushan-Rishathajim, a Mesopotamian king:--Chushan-rishathayim.

H3574.def: from «03787»; prosperity; in plural freedom: -X chain.

H3575.def: or (feminine) Kuwthah {koo-thaw'}; of foreign origin; Cuth or Cuthah, a province of Assyria:--Cuth.

H3576.def: a primitive root; to lie (i.e. deceive), literally or figuratively:--fail, (be found a, make a) liar, lie, lying, be in vain.

H3577.def: from «03576»; falsehood; literally (untruth) or figuratively (idol):--deceitful, false, leasing, + liar, lie, lying.

H3578.def: from «03576»; fallacious; Cozeba, a place in Palestine:--Choseba.

H3580.def: from «03576»; falsified; Kezib, a place in Palestine:--Chezib.

H3581.et: from an unused root meaning to be firm
H3581.def: or (Dan. 11:6) kowach {ko'-akh}; from an unused root meaning to be firm; vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard: -ability, able, chameleon, force, fruits, might, power(-ful), strength, substance, wealth.

H3582.def: a primitive root; to secrete, by act or word; hence (intensively) to destroy:--conceal, cut down (off), desolate, hide.

H3583.def: a primitive root; to paint (with stibium): -paint.

H3584.def: a primitive root; to be untrue, in word (to lie, feign, disown) or deed (to disappoint, fail, cringe):--deceive, deny, dissemble, fail, deal falsely, be found liars, (be-)lie, lying, submit selves.

H3585.def: from «03584»; literally, a failure of flesh, i.e. emaciation; figuratively, hypocrisy:--leanness, lies, lying.

H3588.def: a primitive particle (the full form of the prepositional prefix) indicating causal relations of all kinds, antecedent or consequent; (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed:--and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-)as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al- )though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.

H3589.et: from a primitive root meaning to strike
H3589.def: from a primitive root meaning to strike: a crushing; figuratively, calamity:--destruction.

H3590.def: from the same as «03589» (compare «03539»); properly, something struck off, i.e. a spark (as struck):--spark.

H3591.def: from the same as «03589»; properly, something to strike with, i.e. a dart (perhaps smaller that «02595»):--lance, shield, spear, target.

H3592.def: the same as «03591»; Kidon, a place in Palestine: -Chidon.

H3594.def: from «03559»; properly, a statue, i.e. idol; but used (by euphemism) for some heathen deity (perhaps corresponding to Priapus or Baal-peor):--Chiun.

H3595.def: or kiyor {kee-yore'}; from the same as «03564»; properly, something round (as excavated or bored), i.e. a chafing-dish for coals or a caldron for cooking; hence (from similarity of form) a washbowl; also (for the same reason) a pulpit or platform:--hearth, laver, pan, scaffold.

H3596.et: from (03557) in the sense of withholding
H3596.def: or kelay {kay-lah'-ee}; from «03557» in the sense of withholding; niggardly:--churl.

H3597.et: from an unused root meaning to clap or strike with noise
H3597.def: from an unused root meaning to clap or strike with noise; a club or sledge-hammer:--hammer.

H3598.def: from the same as «03558»; a cluster of stars, i.e. the Pleiades:--Pleiades, seven stars.

H3599.def: a form for «03563»; a cup; also a bag for money or weights:--bag, cup, purse.
